title: We will take [Client] from a blueprint to a business case in two phases over 24 weeks

objectives.text: Develop a new business model centered on a digital marketplace to secure competitive advantage going forward.
Open new revenue streams and future-proof the business, without major cannibalization or short-term loss.
Develop and scale the marketplace with minimal cannibalization; scale globally quickly by leveraging existing assets.
Keep strategic control without losing speed; make sure learnings flow back into the parent organization.

solution.text: The work will run 24 weeks in two phases, one after the other.
Design (6 weeks): Get answers to the key questions to create the blueprint.
Pilot (18 weeks): Build first version and launch with small user group. Test and iterate.
The rollout after the pilot will stay outside the two phases.

outcomes.text: Blueprint with filled-out hypotheses on each component
Detailed project plan for the Pilot phase
Full business case including detailed implementation plan and roadmap
